allocation_recommendations.name: DataFlow Analytics
allocation_recommendations.budget_rationale: Strong health (84) and traction (87) with 18-month runway justifies growth investment. Budget increase supports 2 critical hires and data warehouse scaling. Increase phased over 4 weeks.
allocation_recommendations.headcount_rationale: Hire 1 data architect (critical) and 1 sales engineer to support growth trajectory. DataFlow's 18% monthly growth can absorb headcount expansion.

resource_sharing_targets.description: Share ML model serving infrastructure costs ($2K/month savings for v-004)

allocation_recommendations.name: MediLink Connect
allocation_recommendations.budget_rationale: Traction score 78 with 35% monthly growth and improving CAC/LTV justify measured increase. 14-month runway supports growth hiring. Budget capped at 11.8% due to 6-12 month runway band.
allocation_recommendations.headcount_rationale: Hire 2 engineers (1 critical compliance expert, 1 product) to support rapid traction growth. Regulatory compliance expertise essential for healthcare sector.

resource_sharing_targets.description: Access to DataFlow's data security expertise for HIPAA compliance (consulting basis)

allocation_recommendations.name: TruckRoute Pro
allocation_recommendations.budget_rationale: Status = decision_pending. TruckRoute allocated runway-only budget until governance decision made (kill vs pivot). Recommend decision within 4 weeks given 8-month runway critical window.
allocation_recommendations.headcount_rationale: Reduce to minimal operational headcount pending governance decision. Retain founder + 2 key engineers to maintain option for pivot if approved.

resource_sharing_targets.description: Consolidate shared cloud infrastructure into v-004 primary account during wind-down phase

allocation_recommendations.name: Supply Forecast AI
allocation_recommendations.budget_rationale: Traction score 62 with 11-month runway supports growth hiring within 6-12 month band (20% cap). ML model serving infrastructure needed to scale. Budget increase targeted.
allocation_recommendations.headcount_rationale: Hire ML engineer (critical) and data scientist to improve model accuracy and deployment velocity. These roles directly support traction.

resource_sharing_targets.description: Share data warehouse infrastructure with DataFlow (v-004 becomes secondary consumer, saves $1.5K/month)

resource_sharing_opportunities.description: ML Model Serving: DataFlow's analytics platform and Supply Forecast's ML models both require model serving infrastructure. Consolidate to shared Kubernetes cluster (AWS EKS) vs separate deployments.
Data Security / Compliance: MediLink requires HIPAA compliance, DataFlow has strong data security practice. Share quarterly security reviews and compliance audits (consulting arrangement).
Cloud Infrastructure Consolidation: During TruckRoute's wind-down phase, consolidate its AWS footprint into Supply Forecast's account. Reduces complexity and overhead.

portfolio_impact_summary.expected_portfolio_impact: Reallocation improves portfolio health: (1) Concentrates capital on high-traction ventures (v-001, v-004) with 35%+ monthly growth. (2) Reduces portfolio allocation by $12K/month while increasing headcount in growth ventures, improving efficiency. (3) Improves concentration from 43% to 42% by reducing TruckRoute budget pending decision. (4) Maintains 12.8-month average runway across portfolio. (5) Resource sharing creates $8.5K/month savings when fully implemented (payback in 1-2 months).

allocation_decision.implementation_notes: TruckRoute Pro reduction (v-003) is immediate and assumes governance decision pending status. If decision is deferred, revert to runway-only budget immediately ($20K/month). Resource sharing should be implemented in phases: (1) immediate for expertise sharing (v-002/v-001 compliance); (2) within 2 weeks for infrastructure sharing (v-001/v-004 ML models); (3) within 30 days for TruckRoute consolidation (v-003/v-004). All budget increases phased over 4 weeks to allow hiring ramp-up and integration.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Reducing TruckRoute budget may accelerate deterioration if pivot is chosen post-decision.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Maintain minimum headcount (3 FTE) sufficient to execute pivot if approved. Governance decision must be made within 4 weeks to avoid runway cliff.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Resource sharing between v-001 and v-004 (ML infrastructure) creates new codependency.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Implement with explicit SLA/support model. Each venture retains fallback to independent deployment if shared resource fails. Review dependency quarterly.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Concentration actually increases on DataFlow (from 43% to 42% is only marginal improvement) while increasing its burn.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Offset by reducing TruckRoute. Monitor concentration monthly; if DataFlow concentration exceeds 45% in next review, pause budget increases and reallocate to diversification.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Hiring targets (8 new headcount across 3 ventures) in tight market may face delays.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Prioritize hiring for v-001 and v-002 (both >12 month runway) over v-004 (11-month runway). Use equity/deferred compensation if cash recruitment slows.
